pages.text: The $(#009AFF)Source List$() needs to be $(bold)bound to a maid$() to be used. Using the Source List, you can control whether the maid charges the Source Jars within her work area, and you can also edit their charging order.

pages.title: Binding and Unbinding
pages.text: $(#009AFF)$(k:use)$() on a maid to bind her. When binding, it will synchronize all chargeable blocks currently scanned by the maid.;$(br2)Use $(#009AFF)$(k:sneak)$() + $(#009AFF)$(k:use)$() to unbind.

pages.title: Forbid Charging
pages.text: After binding a maid, when holding the Source List in your hand, all chargeable blocks within the maid's work area will be highlighted in white. At this time, using $(#009AFF)$(k:use)$() on a highlighted block will set it to the $(#FF0000)Forbid Charging$() state, and it will be highlighted in red.$(br2)After finishing adjustments, place the source list into the maid's bauble slot, and the maid will ignore blocks set to "Forbid Charging" when charging.$(br2)Holding the Source List and using $(#009AFF)$(k:use)$() on a block set to "Forbid Charging" will restore the maid's charging for that block.

pages.title: Adjust Charging Order
pages.text: After binding a maid, when holding the Source List in your hand, it will also display that block's charging order above the block. Aim at a highlighted block and use $(#009AFF)$(k:maid_mana_source.sort_source)$() + $(#009AFF)$(k:pickItem)$() to adjust that block's charging order.$(br2)After finishing adjustments, place the source list into the maid's bauble slot, and the maid will charge in the order you have set.

pages.title: Memory Synchronization
pages.text: When the Source List is placed in the maid's bauble slot, it will synchronize the chargeable blocks scanned by the maid in real-time. If new chargeable blocks are added, they will be added directly to the end of the list and will be chargeable by the maid by default.$(br2)Changing a block's position will be treated as adding a new block.
